text.p: PVC Container Corp said Thursday it is looking for opportunities to grow through acquisitions, and that it expects consolidation in the plastic bottle industry.
"The company is also exploring opportunities to grow its business through acquisition," said president and chief executive Phillip Friedman.

"We believe the plastic container bottle industry is sufficiently fragmented so that increased competition will cause industry consolidation during the next several years. PVC has maintained a healthy balance sheet that will allow us to take advantage of acquisition opportunities as they arise," he said.
PVC said Thursday third quarter net income was $791,000 or $0.11 per share, down from $1,073,000 or $0.16 per share for the same period last year.
For the nine months ended March 31, 1997, revenues were $41,443,000 versus $41,048,000 for the same period a year ago.

The company attributed flat revenues for the year to underutilization of some of the company's new plastic bottle capacity and development of the company's new entry into PET injection molded bottles.
